simple.meaning: צַאֲנָן (Tsaʼănân) is a Hebrew word meaning “Zaanan , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צַאֲנָן (H6630) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in צַאֲנָן (H6630) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: צַאֲנָן (Tsaʼănân) / H6630 is traced through Micah 1:11 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H6630. Tsaanan צַאֲנָן proper name, of a location Micah 1:11 Σεννααρ [ ν ], perhaps = צְנָן in the Shephelah of Judah Josh 15:37 , Σεννα ( μ ). [ צֶאֱצָא ] see יצא . I, II. צָב see I, II. צבב .
definitions.rootNote: from the same as 6629 used denominatively; sheep pasture ;
